title: The Whole Set, And How Much Of It
label: ch:el-conjunto-y-el-resto
canDo: I can say el conjunto, entero, la mayoria, el resto and escaso, and say why a whole thing is one nobody has touched.

payoff.summary: Complete ES-C352-escaso: name a set, say it is whole, name most of it, name what is left, and say there is not enough.
